micro_interview.question: Suppose X and Y are independent standard normal random variables. Define U=X+Y and V=X−Y. Are U and V independent? Explain how you would establish your answer rather than relying on intuition.
micro_interview.demonstrate: Linear algebra/probability fluency, covariance reasoning, awareness of the special role of joint Gaussian variables, and precise communication.
micro_interview.practice: Give yourself 5 minutes on paper, then explain the argument aloud in English in under 3 minutes. Focus on assumptions and the logical step that converts zero covariance into independence in this specific setting.
